instruction: Move and click the small flat switch tan top

source.instruction: Move and click the small flat switch tan top

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the switch, which was at x = +24 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: close left gripper to prepare for pushing/clicking the switch
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips stayed in place, now 61 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the switch; closed the gripper (opening 0.00: nothing held)

frames.label: turn 6
